spec.name: M5.ConditionalCount.restricted_subset_domain
spec.statement: ∀ (W : Finset ℕ) (d k : ℕ), (M5.ConditionalCount.restricted W d).powersetCard k = (W.powersetCard k).filter (fun U => ∀ s ∈ U, d ∣ s)
spec.guidance: Extensionality and Finset.mem_powersetCard. Subset of W.filter means subset of W and every element satisfies divisibility. Return tactic lines only without leading by; keep exact target.

spec.name: M5.ConditionalCount.two_block_completion_count
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (A B WA WB : Finset ℕ) (kA kB : ℕ), P.Monic → Disjoint A WA → Disjoint B WB → M5.ConditionalCount.nSelected P A WA kA * M5.ConditionalCount.nSelected P B WB kB = M5.ConditionalCount.twoBlockIndicatorSum P A B WA WB kA kB
spec.guidance: Unfold nSelected using monicity and rewrite accepted M5.CompletionBlock.completion_count in both blocks. Distribute product of finite filter cardinalities into double indicator sum. Domains, selected residues and kA,kB are separate; do not replace them by a square. Return tactic lines only without leading by; keep exact target.

spec.name: M5.ConditionalCount.selected_divisor_indicator
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (A B U V : Finset ℕ), 0 < N → M5.ConditionalCount.selectedDivisorSum N A B U V = (if M5.Connectivity.supportGcd N (A ∪ U) (B ∪ V) = 1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
spec.guidance: The selected supportGcd divides positive N and is positive. Apply Connectivity.connected_indicator at that gcd to U,V. Identify resulting gcd with supportGcd N(A union U)(B union V), using Finset.gcd_union and Nat gcd associativity/commutativity, or divisibility antisymmetry with support_gcd_dvd. Return tactic lines only without leading by; keep exact target.

spec.name: M5.ConditionalCount.conditional_arithmetic_expansion
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (A B WA WB : Finset ℕ), 0 < N → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → M5.ConditionalCount.PrefixOK N w A B WA WB → M5.ConditionalCount.rawCompletion N w F A B WA WB = ∑ U ∈ WA.powersetCard (w-A.card), ∑ V ∈ WB.powersetCard (w-B.card), M5.ConditionalCount.pairIndicator N F A B U V
spec.guidance: Use accepted PolynomialIndicator.residual_factors_regular to show each F*product monic. Restrictions of available sets remain disjoint from selected sets. Apply two_block_completion_count and restricted_subset_domain, distribute sums/indicators and perform explicit Finset.sum_comm permutations. Do not use simp[sum_comm], which loops. Pointwise conditional cases close the rearrangement. Prefix deficits are w-A.card and w-B.card exactly. Return tactic lines only without leading by; keep exact target.

spec.name: M5.ConditionalCount.exact_completion_C
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (A B WA WB : Finset ℕ), 0 < N → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → M5.ConditionalCount.PrefixOK N w A B WA WB → M5.ConditionalCount.completionC N w F A B WA WB = (M5.ConditionalCount.validCompletions N w F A B WA WB).card
spec.guidance: PrefixOK supplies both cardinality guards, disjointness and physical prefix constraints. Expand rawCompletion, apply selected_divisor_indicator and accepted PolynomialIndicator.exact_signature_indicator. For U,V in powersetCard domains, disjointness and Nat.add_sub_of_le give union cardinality w. Identify double 0/1 sum with validCompletions filter cardinality. Multiplicities and cancellations retained. Return tactic lines only without leading by; keep exact target.

spec.name: M5.ConditionalCount.completion_nonnegative_and_exists
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (A B WA WB : Finset ℕ), 0 < N → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → M5.ConditionalCount.PrefixOK N w A B WA WB → (0 ≤ M5.ConditionalCount.completionC N w F A B WA WB ∧ (0 < M5.ConditionalCount.completionC N w F A B WA WB ↔ (M5.ConditionalCount.validCompletions N w F A B WA WB).Nonempty))
spec.guidance: Rewrite exact_completion_C. Natural cardinality is nonnegative and positive iff the finite completion set is nonempty. This is exact semantic existence; the branch recovery algorithm is a subsequent original obligation. Return tactic lines only without leading by; keep exact target.
